stem.text: A camera drone of mass $1.20\,\text{kg}$ hovers at a fixed point above the ground. The drone has four propellers.

stem.alt: Drawing of a drone with four propellers and a camera underneath, labelled camera and propeller.

stem.text: In a time of $1.00\,\text{s}$, each propeller pushes a mass of $0.400\,\text{kg}$ of air vertically downwards.
Assume that the air above the propellers is stationary.
What is the speed of the air leaving each propeller?
